topics.titleTr: Bilgi Calisanlari Icin Gunluk AI Is Akislari
topics.titleEn: Daily AI Workflows for Knowledge Workers
topics.angle: how-to + practical daily routines that put ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini to real work
topics.brief: Story-led playbook of daily AI routines for knowledge workers. Sections: inbox and meeting triage; turning notes into drafts and decisions (ChatGPT Work / Claude); research and summarizing with citations you verify; Gemini inside Workspace for docs and sheets; scheduled/recurring tasks; guardrails against over-trusting output and leaking sensitive data. Verify: ChatGPT Work and agent/scheduled-task capabilities; Gemini-in-Workspace features in 2026. Sources: vendor guides; productivity write-ups. End with a copy-and-adapt daily template and a 'never delegate this' list.

topics.titleTr: AI ile Kod Incelemesi: Guven Ama Dogrula
topics.titleEn: AI Code Review: Trust, but Verify
topics.angle: mistakes + use AI code reviewers well and know exactly what they miss
topics.brief: Contrarian guide to AI code review as a complement, not a replacement, for human review. Sections: what AI reviewers catch reliably (style, obvious bugs, boilerplate risks) versus what they miss (intent, architecture, security context, subtle concurrency); false-positive fatigue and how to tune it; keeping humans on design and security-critical paths; integrating AI review in the pipeline without rubber-stamping. Verify: 2026 reality that a large share of code is AI-generated, raising review stakes. Sources: 2026 AI-coding trend reports; review best-practice guides. End with an AI-plus-human review checklist. Distinct from general code-review process posts.
